name: tally_status
summary: Check TallyPrime reachability, active company, and circuit breaker health. Use when: check connection, tally health, system status. READ-ONLY.
example: Is TallyPrime connected and what is the current circuit breaker status?

name: tally_list_companies
summary: List all open and available companies loaded in TallyPrime. Use when: which companies are available, switch company, list accounts. READ-ONLY.
example: List all the companies open in TallyPrime right now.

name: tally_set_active_company
summary: Set the active company for read queries in this session. Use when: switch active company, select company, set context. READ-ONLY.
example: Switch active company to 'ABC Traders Pvt Ltd'.

name: tally_list_ledgers
summary: List all ledger accounts, parent groups, and balances in the active company. Use when: chart of accounts, find ledger, party accounts. READ-ONLY.
example: List all Sundry Creditors and their current balances.

name: tally_trial_balance
summary: Export structured Trial Balance report from TallyPrime with debit/credit closing totals. Use when: trial balance, balance check, financial health. READ-ONLY.
example: Generate the trial balance for the current financial year to date.

name: tally_day_book
summary: Export Day Book transactions as deterministic JSON array of vouchers. Use when: day book, daily transactions, recent vouchers. READ-ONLY.
example: Show me all transactions recorded in the Day Book for yesterday.

name: tally_draft_voucher
summary: Stage a TallyPrime voucher draft with double-entry balance validation and out-of-band approval URL. Use when: create voucher, post entry, draft transaction. DRAFT: human approval required.
example: Draft a payment voucher for Rs 15,000 to Apex Supplies from HDFC Bank.

name: tally_preview_draft
summary: Preview formatted summary and exact XML payload of a staged voucher draft. Use when: inspect draft, review XML, verify staged entry. READ-ONLY.
example: Preview staged draft voucher with ID 'dft_98745'.

name: tally_discard_draft
summary: Discard and purge an unapproved voucher draft from local staging storage. Use when: cancel draft, delete staged entry, reject voucher. READ-ONLY.
example: Discard draft voucher 'dft_12345'.

name: tally_commit_draft
summary: Post an approved voucher into TallyPrime using a human-authorized approval token. Use when: human approved draft, finalize voucher. DRAFT: human approval required.
example: Commit draft 'dft_45678' with the human approval token.

name: tally_extract_document
summary: Extract structured accounting data from invoice PDF or image for voucher drafting. Use when: scan invoice, parse bill PDF, OCR receipt. READ-ONLY.
example: Extract data from 'invoices/bill_101.pdf' for drafting.

name: tally_run_report
summary: Execute a read-only financial report from an extensible TDL pack. Use when: custom report, financial summary, ageing pack. READ-ONLY.
example: Run the 'outstanding_ageing' report pack for the current quarter.

name: tally_get_environment
summary: Get TallyPrime connection status: Tally version, open company, edit-log on/off, server version, tested versions. Use when: check connection, which company is open, version support. READ-ONLY.
example: Which Tally company is open, and is my TallyPrime version supported?

name: tally_explain_gstr2b_mismatches
summary: Explain GSTR-2B vs TallyPrime books mismatches (ITC reconciliation): matched, partial, only-in-books, only-on-portal, with likely cause and next step. Use when: GSTR-2B reconciliation, ITC mismatch. READ-ONLY.
example: Reconcile GSTR-2B for September 2026 and list the top 10 mismatches with likely causes. Draft follow-ups for the suppliers.

name: tally_list_receivables_ageing
summary: List TallyPrime receivables ageing (sundry debtors outstanding) in 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ day buckets with last payment date. Use when: who owes money, overdue customers, payment chase. READ-ONLY; reminder drafts never sent.
example: Show customers overdue by more than 60 days, largest first, and draft a polite reminder for each.

name: tally_diagnose_connection
summary: Diagnose TallyPrime connection problems: Tally not running, XML/HTTP server off, wrong port, firewall, no company open, version mismatch. Use when: cannot connect to Tally, timeouts, company not found. READ-ONLY.
example: TallyMCP cannot connect to Tally. Diagnose it and tell me the first fix to try.

name: tally_check_audit_trail
summary: Check TallyPrime audit trail: edit log on/off, last backup if detectable, recent voucher alterations and deletions. Use when: data integrity, before big batch, did anyone change entries. READ-ONLY; never repairs.
example: Is the edit log on, and what vouchers were altered or deleted this month?

name: tally_draft_bank_vouchers
summary: Draft TallyPrime Receipt/Payment/Contra vouchers from a bank statement (CSV, XLSX or PDF) with duplicate detection and closing-balance check. Use when: bank statement import, BRS entries. DRAFT: human approval required.
example: Draft vouchers from this HDFC statement for the HDFC Bank ledger. Flag duplicates and anything you cannot map.

name: tally_check_books_health
summary: Check TallyPrime books for errors: duplicate vouchers, negative cash/stock, missing opening balances, odd ledger groups, invalid GSTIN, round-figure and cash-limit flags, with risk score. Use when: audit review, month-end. READ-ONLY.
example: Check last quarter's books for duplicates, negative balances and unusual cash entries.

name: tally_draft_vouchers_from_table
summary: Draft TallyPrime sales, purchase, payment or journal vouchers from an Excel/CSV/JSON table with column mapping and a dry-run summary. Use when: bulk voucher import, Excel to Tally. DRAFT: human approval required.
example: Import these 150 sales rows as draft vouchers. Do a dry run first.

name: tally_export_report
summary: Export TallyPrime ledgers, vouchers, outstandings or trial balance to CSV/XLSX with a stable column schema for Excel or Power BI. Use when: Tally to Excel, Power BI dataset. READ-ONLY; writes only to the export folder.
example: Export this year's trial balance to Excel.

name: tally_internal_audit
summary: Execute comprehensive transaction-audit pipeline (S0-S9) and generate deterministic report. READ-ONLY.
example: Run full internal transaction audit for this financial year.

name: tally_toolsets
summary: List, enable, or disable toolsets dynamically (core, books, audit, drafting, docs, insights). META.
example: Enable the audit toolset for this session.

name: tally_get_result
summary: Retrieve stored large result chunk or section by handle. META.
example: Fetch page 2 of result handle h_123.

name: tally_stock_check
summary: Check inventory: negative balances, book vs physical variance, valuation methods, and ageing. READ-ONLY.
example: Check for any negative stock balances in Tally.

name: tally_voucher_check
summary: Verify voucher numbering sequence gaps, duplicates, high-value outliers, cash limits, and holidays. READ-ONLY.
example: Scan Day Book for voucher sequence gaps and cash payments above 10,000.

name: tally_ledger_check
summary: Audit cost centre allocations, related party flows, unrecorded bank items, and suspense balances. READ-ONLY.
example: Check uncleared cheques older than 90 days in bank ledgers.

name: tally_compliance_check
summary: Verify GSTR-2B ITC matches, blocked credits, TDS deductions, and Section 43B(h) MSME overdue. READ-ONLY.
example: Check supplier bills pending past 45 days for MSME 43B(h) disallowance.

name: tally_draft_invoice
summary: Stage Sales, Purchase, Credit Note, or Debit Note draft with automatic CGST/SGST/IGST tax splits. DRAFT-ONLY.
example: Draft a purchase voucher for supplier Acme Corp with 18% GST.

name: tally_draft_master
summary: Stage ledger, party, stock item, or group master with fuzzy Jaro-Winkler duplicate protection. DRAFT-ONLY.
example: Draft a new Sundry Creditor ledger for ABC Logistics.

name: tally_cfo_snapshot
summary: High-level financial overview: cash, debtor ageing, margin delta, MSME overdue, and 5 risk flags. READ-ONLY.
example: Provide CFO executive snapshot comparing current FY to previous period.

name: audit_sec_269ss_loan_acceptance
summary: Detects acceptance of loans, deposits, or specified advances in cash >= ₹20,000 with 100% penalty under Sec 271D. Form 3CD Clause 31(a) exception report. READ-ONLY.
example: Audit Section 269SS compliance for cash loans received exceeding ₹20,000.

name: audit_sec_269t_loan_repayment
summary: Detects repayment of loan, deposit, or specified advance in cash when repayment or balance >= ₹20,000 with 100% penalty under Sec 271E. Form 3CD Clause 31(b). READ-ONLY.
example: Audit Section 269T compliance for cash loan repayments exceeding ₹20,000.

name: audit_sec_40a3_cash_expenditure
summary: Identifies cash payments to a single person in a day exceeding ₹10,000 (₹35,000 for transporters) for Form 3CD Clause 21(d) disallowance with Rule 6DD filters. READ-ONLY.
example: Scan cash expenses for Section 40A(3) disallowance exceeding ₹10,000 or ₹35,000.

name: audit_labour_pf_esi_36_1_va
summary: Validates timely deduction & deposit of EPF/ESI against statutory due date (15th) for permanent disallowance under Sec 36(1)(va) (Checkmate ruling) and Sec 43B. Form 3CD Clause 20(b). READ-ONLY.

params.desc: Statutory due day of following month (default: 15)

example: Check PF and ESI deposit dates against statutory due dates for Section 36(1)(va) disallowance.
